---
title: "Search"
---

Search reads the index of the version you are in. Askr does not add another
index, and it does not search across versions.

```yaml
website:
  search:
    location: navbar
    type: overlay
```

At 1280px and wider the button sits on the right, immediately left of the
theme toggle, and the header stays one row. Below that width it moves to the
left.

Render each frozen version with a `site-url` that includes its directory, so
its `search.json` and result links stay inside that directory:

```yaml
# the render that is published to /v0.2/
website:
  site-url: https://example.github.io/project/v0.2/
```

The render copied to `/` uses the site root, without a version directory.
Searching from a v0.2 page then uses `/v0.2/search.json` only. Version folders
and the version menu are set up on [Versioning Docs](versions.qmd).
